build_CudaGraphManager: build a CudaGraphManager to capture and replay CUDA graphs for vLLM GPU inference batching
create_CudaGraphManager_capture: create CUDA graph captures for vLLM model forward passes with configurable capture sizes and graph modes
run_CudaGraphManager_dispatch: run the CudaGraphManager dispatch to find matching CUDA graph descriptors for given batch sizes
run_ModelCudaGraphManager_run_fullgraph: run the ModelCudaGraphManager run_fullgraph to replay captured FULL CUDA graphs and return hidden states
build_prepare_inputs_to_capture: build prepared attention inputs and slot mappings for CUDA graph capture in vLLM model inference
